assets.alt_text: Two worker honey bees, with the bee on the right showing a darker, shinier hair-reduced appearance associated with CBPV-type signs
assets.caption: CBPV-type adult appearance. Darkening and reduced hair can resemble the shiny, hairless appearance described in chronic bee paralysis, but appearance alone does not confirm CBPV.
assets.diagnostic_boundary: Do not diagnose CBPV from this photograph; interpret with colony-level clinical pattern and appropriate diagnostic evidence.
